346077.カレルは さる遠方の王国に招かれ\n親善試合で ウデを披露することになりました。:
She was invited to a distant kingdom,
where she would showcase her skills in
a friendly match.

346078.ところが カレルは その大切な試合の中で\n誤って 対戦相手の男を\n殺してしま:
However, during her match...she nearly killed
her opponent by mistake.

346079.しかし すんでのところで\n男はカレルの剣をかわし 勝負は引き分けとなり\n彼は:
But at the very last moment, the man swiftly
dodged Karel's blade...resulting in a draw.
He then revealed his true identity.

346080.なんと 男は その王国の王子\nエルヴィンだったのです。:
As it turned out, the man was the prince of
that kingdom. His name was Elvin.

346081.エルヴィンは 自分をここまで追い詰めた者は\n初めてだと言い カレルに\n自分の:
Elvin remarked that Karel was the first person
to ever push him this far. Thus, he invited
her to become his partner.

346082.カレルは その申し出を受け入れ\n以来 ふたりは どこに行くにも\n行動を 共に:
Karel accepted his offer. From then on,
the two of them were inseparable as
they went everywhere together.

346083.エルヴィンと カレルの剣を前にして\nかなう者はなく ふたりは\nあの魔皇軍の軍:
None could hope to stand a chance facing the
blades of them both. Time and time again, they
drove back the Dark Dominion's forces.

346084.やがて ふたりは\n国王や王妃 エルヴィンの妹のヴァスタニア姫に\n婚姻すること:
In time, the two of them informed the king,
queen, and Elvin's younger sister Vastania
of their intention to marry...

346085.互いの剣を交差させるように 掲げると\n夫婦となる誓いを 立てました。:
Holding their swords high, they crossed their
blades as one and exchanged their vows to
be wed as husband and wife.

346086.王国には その時の像が建造され\nふたりは しあわせに 暮らしましたとさ。:
A statue commemorating the momentous occasion
was erected in the kingdom, and the two of
them lived happily ever after.

353569.……昔 カレルという女性の剣士が\n世に名を馳せていた 時のこと。:
Long ago, there was a female swordsman
named Karel who made a name for herself.
